displayDescription: Dusk storybook scene: Mira waters a glowing idea-flower, and light arcs connect and light up the village houses.
styleRenderer: Rough.js 4.6.6 (local esbuild bundle rough.bundle.js, fixed seeds, cached drawables)
motionEngine: GSAP paused timeline (window.__timelines.video), one tween per state property; Canvas redrawn from timeline state on update and hf-seek
limitations: The scene is illustrative and procedural. The paper grain is a seeded static noise overlay, and the glows are canvas radial gradients and shadow blur, not physical lighting.

The dusk sky, moon, lavender hills, ridge and foliage-dark colours are scene-dependent choices informed by the source lighting-state lesson. The style tokens keep their roles: ink outlines, terracotta hero, sage hill/can, gold light/houses, cream lettering/windows.
PixiJS was not needed: there are no large sprite or particle sets.
The camera move is limited to a 14px parallax settle of the near foliage, so the stationary background is not moved.
Rough.js contains Math.random only as a fallback when no seed is set; every drawable here has an explicit seed.
The source review covered sampled stills only. The motion timing here is authored, not copied.
